sentences.en: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light.
sentences.zh: 他作为目击者来为那束光作证。

sentences.en: This lady witnessed an accident at three o'clock this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这位女士今天下午三点目睹了一起事故。

sentences.en: It was the court's finding that the witness committed perjury.
sentences.zh: 法庭认定这名证人伪证。
